prompts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: standalone storyboard draft illustration, square 1024x1024.
Primary request: Generate a NEW, extremely simple flat schematic drawing of a wrecked bathroom. The supplied photo is a COMPOSITION REFERENCE ONLY; do not stylize or repaint its photographic detail.
Input image 1 role: composition reference, frontal eye-level view into a narrow corridor bathroom.
Scene: radiator on the left wall, toilet at left rear, sink and rectangular mirror on the right wall, broken old bathtub centered against the rear wall. A few small angular rubble shapes near the bathtub. Two or three basic rectangular ceiling lamps hang crooked on simple cables. No people.
Style: very very simplified vector-like bitmap storyboard draft. Primitive geometric silhouettes, sparse uniform bold dark outlines, solid flat fills, lots of clear shapes. Broad perspective construction with at most 4–5 tile-grid lines per surface; no dense tiling. Omit towels, bottles and little fittings. Do not render photographic surfaces.
Palette: use exactly three solid colours throughout: light paper gray #E8EDF0, dark ink #1C2A35, muted blue #8FABBC. Every shape uses one of those colours. Paper-gray ground, dark ink outlines and select silhouettes, muted blue on broad surfaces. No other colour, no gradients, no texture, no tonal shading.
Composition: same frontal eye-level corridor layout as reference, long central view to broken bathtub, edge-to-edge square scene.
Constraints: one image only, no montage or sheet, no panel border, no numbers, no captions, no writing, no VO, no logos, no watermark. No photorealism, no 3D rendering, no architectural detail, no hatching, no speckle. Minimum geometry needed to communicate this scene.

Use case: illustration-story
Primary request: Simplify the supplied bathroom drawing into an EXTREMELY MINIMAL schematic storyboard draft. Keep the same eye-level frontal corridor composition and objects: radiator left, toilet rear left, sink and mirror right, broken tub rear, crooked dangling ceiling lamps, a few rubble shapes, small hammer/crowbar on floor.
Change only the visual complexity: reduce this to primitive shapes and truly FLAT solid fills. The current image has too much tiling and too much dimensional rendering.
IMPORTANT simplification: remove the entire repeated small tile grid. Use only TWO horizontal wall lines and TWO vertical division lines on each wall; the rest is large uninterrupted colour. Floor has THREE perspective lines and TWO cross-lines total. Draw radiator as one rectangle with THREE rungs. Draw sink, toilet, tub, tools and lamps as schematic glyphs made of a few flat polygons each. Outline everything with a simple even 7px dark ink line. No bevels, curved shading, reflections, highlights or naturalistic silhouettes.
Exactly three solid palette fills: background paper gray #E8EDF0, dark ink #1C2A35, muted blue #8FABBC. The fills must be completely UNIFORM with zero gradients or texture. Use the paper gray for most walls/ceiling/floor; muted blue for a few object fills. Flat posterized 2D illustration; primitive storyboard blocking sketch.
Square 1024x1024 edge-to-edge single scene, no borders, no montage, no labels or text, no people, no watermark.

caption.title: Uneasy arrival
caption.action: A slow camera move through a wrecked bathroom. Loose lamps flicker and spark; horror ambience builds, then the lights go out.
caption.vo: Wordt je badkamerrenovatie een ware horrorfilm?
caption.alt: Draft of a damaged bathroom with hanging lamps and a broken bathtub

Scene: A close view of a broadly tiled wall, in the wall-and-spotlight composition of reference 1. A basic flashlight silhouette enters from the lower-left corner, aimed toward the center-right. Show its beam as a hard-edged paper-gray cone and a large hard-edged pale spot on a muted-blue wall, no soft lighting or glow. Inside the pale spotlight, render exactly the readable English text "LEAVE IT TO THE PROS." in simple dark ink uppercase sans-serif lettering on two or three centered lines. The message is clean schematic lettering, not creepy handwriting. Keep surrounding wall very simple, four or five grid lines total. No person or hand. No other text.

Use case: text-localization. Edit target: the supplied square, flat schematic storyboard illustration of a flashlight illuminating a tiled wall. Change ONLY the text inside the light spot. Replace the entire English inscription "LEAVE IT TO THE PROS." with the exact Dutch text "Laat het over aan de profs" (no period). Render verbatim, with capital L and the other letters lowercase, as bold clear dark sans-serif lettering, centered within the light spot. Arrange in three lines as "Laat het" / "over aan" / "de profs" so it reads clearly at a small size. Preserve everything else: exact square crop, flashlight at lower left, beam geometry and circular spot, existing tile lines and their positions, line thickness, flat three-colour pale paper-gray/dark-ink/muted-blue palette. Do not add any text, objects, shading, texture or decorative detail. This is a tiny language correction to the same drawing.

caption.title: The message
caption.action: A flashlight sweeps across the tiled wall, revealing a message: “Laat het over aan de profs”.
caption.vo: Laat het over aan de profs.
caption.alt: Draft of a flashlight illuminating a message on a tiled wall
